definitions.post_seconds: client monotonic request-to-final SSE complete; measured POSTs only
definitions.visible_ttft: first nonempty content delta, excludes reasoning deltas
definitions.completion_tokens: includes reasoning and visible output; usage has no token-level decomposition
definitions.reasoning_characters: count only, not retained CoT, not reasoning tokens
definitions.cached_tokens: LLM prompt prefix counter, not vision encoder cache hits
definitions.fixed_and_specialty: deliberate comparison diagnostics, separate from ordinary autonomous browsing
definitions.probe_removal_savings: not measured; reported probe duration is only an optimistic upper bound, not a prediction
definitions.packet_characters: reconstructed CC segments incl. cid with json.dumps ensure_ascii=False; not a saved original wire prompt
definitions.classification_probe_count: ordinary classification uses native /apply-template plus /tokenize; zero max_tokens=1 posts does not mean no token-counting work; non-generation endpoints are not timed separately

findings: Sequential measured POST time covers 98.44% of Mini main-replay wall and 99.65% of E2B; residual 3.36s/4.45s includes local cache, tokenizer/properties endpoints and orchestration. This cache replay does not measure fresh-platform fetch throughput.
All 26 count probes per model are immediately followed by a generation with equal reported prompt_tokens; all 52 pairings checked against per-request hashes and timing usage.

E2B: all 8 fixed-comment and 5 summary generations cache prompt_tokens-1. Count probe duration in these stages is consistent with necessary prefill moved to the prior request; removing it need not remove that work.

E2B: 13 image-caption generations and their 13 probes report cached_tokens=0. Mini: all 59 posts report zero. Source allows multimodal prefix reuse; exact runtime cause is not identified by these artifacts.

Within ordinary operating POST time, classification accounts for 67.2% Mini and 54.0% E2B; image captions account for 18.0% Mini and 32.8% E2B. Benchmark and calibration repeats must not obscure this production-stage attribution.
E2B caption generation output/decode and ordinary classification input structure are the strongest measured hotspots. No observed real generation exhausted 4096 output tokens.

192 tutorial CC segments contain 2197 text characters, but reconstructed segment JSON is 23439 characters, including 6610 ID characters. E2B classification prompt is 18504 tokens; fixed-body prompt on same video is 2416 with different task content.
Fixed 8 bodies and repeated visual specialties are benchmark-only stages. Their cost is separately recorded, not attributed to mandatory per-video production work.

E4B ubatch32 to16 changes logged compute buffers by 11.67 MiB with same KV. Admission available-memory delta 89.199 MiB and whole-run delta 40.004 MiB are not solely batch-size gains: OS baseline available memory differs by about 1006.668 MiB.
suggested_separate_experiments: Compact content-decision packet using validated short segment indexes mapped to full source IDs by backend, keep original text, CID/timestamps and full source provenance; measure actual tokens and latency before/after without cutting 128K window.

Keep thinking enabled; independently compare a positively brief stage instruction or supported explicit reasoning budget on same inputs. Preserve raw output, stop reason and factual/OC review. Lower max_tokens alone has no demonstrated benefit because these runs already stop far below 4096.

Use same image bytes/messages to inspect rendered-prefix/slot/checkpoint logs; measure complete count+generation vs a justified alternative. Do not assume cache RAM or disabled multimodal KV-shift reuse fixes zero cached_tokens.

Amortize the existing endpoint/resource admission probe across unchanged provider identity; separate calibration and intentional repeated benchmark stages from sustained online throughput reporting. No admission bypass is suggested.
